opportunity_writer_timing.scope: Every 64th record per category, starting with its first record. Measured processing samples only; queue waiting and status publication are excluded. No recorded waiting demotion excludes this observed direct path in this window, not earlier actions, unobserved paths, indirect effects or other cache eviction.
